scoring_justification: Checker recomputes f, g, B^s, and Ks from the agent's submitted σ, t, ξ using double series with higher truncation and compares values with absolute tolerance 1e-6.

outputs.description: Intermediate computed auxiliary functions f and g.
Surface magnetoelastic tensor components (normalized by 2πMs²) and surface anisotropy constant for each roughness parameter point.

output_contract.notes: The agent must choose at least 8 parameter points covering the ranges σ=2‑15 Å, t=10,30 Å, ξ=10,30 Å. The checker recomputes gold values via high‑truncation double series and compares each submitted value with absolute tolerance 1e‑6.

steps.description: Recompute surface magnetoelastic tensor components and anisotropy constant from the agent-submitted σ,t,ξ; compare each value with absolute tolerance 1e-6. Score is fraction of values within tolerance, requiring at least 8 parameter rows.
